Hybrid Calisthenics App (Home Workout)
Having an early win gives us quick feedback that our work pays off. This helps us maintain motivation and consistency over years for bigger goals.
While discipline is important, it also helps us to know that we're applying the discipline towards the right things. Discipline helps us to hard things, but not all hard things are worth doing.
